top_signals.title: Stock Futures Rise as Anthropic Fuels AI Optimism: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks lifted global equities after stellar revenue growth at Anthropic PBC bolstered the view that massive spending on artificial intelligence will be sustained. The dollar touched a three-month low.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Vista Energy up 5% after billionaire Peter Thiel buys stake in the Argentine shale oil producer
top_signals.summary: Peter Thiel’s hedge fund disclosed a $76 million stake in Argentine oil producer Vista Energy, sending its shares higher in premarket trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
